title: Oculi: A Conversational Agentic Platform for Automated Credit Risk Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2608.28944v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Credit risk analysis in financial institutions traditionally requires analysts to manually write SQL queries, run statistical computations, and build visualization dashboards. This is a time-consuming workflow that limits exploration to familiar segments. We introduce \textbf{Oculi}, a conversational platform that transforms natural language questions into comprehensive credit risk analyses, complete with data queries, statistical testing, and interactive visualizations. Oculi employs a three-layer architecture that separates reasoning (LLM-powered agent), execution (Model Context Protocol tool servers), and presentation (agentic UI), enabling analysts to discover high-risk portfolio segments. Within Oculi, a new segment discovery pipeline is proposed that combines deterministic statistical methods with LLM-guided feature selection, leveraging LLM semantic domain knowledge alongside data-driven metrics to identify meaningful, actionable

translated_title: Oculi：一个用于自动化信用风险分析的对话式智能体平台
translated_abstract: 金融机构中的信用风险分析传统上需要分析师手动编写SQL查询、运行统计计算并构建可视化仪表板，这是一种耗时的工作流程，限制了探索范围仅限于熟悉的细分领域。我们提出了Oculi，一个对话式平台，能够将自然语言问题转化为全面的信用风险分析，包括数据查询、统计检验和交互式可视化。Oculi采用三层架构，将推理（由大语言模型驱动的智能体）、执行（模型上下文协议工具服务器）和展示（智能体UI）进行分离，使分析师能够发现高风险的投资组合细分。在Oculi中，我们提出了一种新的细分发现流水线，它将确定性统计方法与LLM引导的特征选择相结合，利用LLM的语义领域知识与数据驱动指标来识别有意义且可操作的（细分领域）。
tldr: Oculi是一个对话式智能体平台，通过分离推理、执行与展示的三层架构，将自然语言问题自动转化为包含数据查询、统计检验和交互式可视化的完整信用风险分析，并提出结合确定性统计方法与LLM引导特征选择的细分发现流水线，帮助分析师发现高风险投资组合细分。
en_tdlr: Oculi is a conversational agentic platform that transforms natural language questions into comprehensive credit risk analyses with data queries, statistical testing, and interactive visualizations, featuring a three-layer architecture separating reasoning, execution, and presentation, along with a novel segment discovery pipeline combining deterministic statistical methods with LLM-guided feature selection.
